newsitem.title: ISRAEL: New chairman for Israel Discount Bank.
newsitem.headline: New chairman for Israel Discount Bank.

text.p: Israel Discount Bank said on Thursday it planned to appoint Arie Mientkavich, currently head of Israel's Securities Authority, as chairman of its board.
"The appointment will go into effect three months from the day Mientkavich leaves the Securities Authority," the bank said in a statement. It did not disclose when he would step down.

Mientkavich's appointment was approved at the bank's annual shareholders' meeting on Thursday but it must also be ratified by a government committee overseeing the entry of public servants into private sector managerial positions.
Gideon Lahav has agreed to stay on as chairman of Israel's third largest bank until Mientkavich can take over.
